mapper.insert: insert into business_audit_event (domain_type, domain_id, owner_member_id, actor_type, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, action, target_type, target_id, relation_id, before_json, after_json, reason, request_id, create_time) values (#{domainType}, #{domainId}, #{ownerMemberId}, COALESCE(#{actorType}, 'UNKNOWN'), #{actorMemberId}, #{actorRoleCode}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{relationId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{reason}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{requestId}, ''), SHA2(CONCAT_WS(':', #{domainType}, #{domainId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, COALESCE(#{targetId}, 0), COALESCE(#{relationId}, 0)), 256)), #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, domain_type, domain_id, owner_member_id, actor_type, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, action, target_type, target_id, relation_id, before_json, after_json, reason, request_id, create_time from business_audit_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} order by create_time desc, id desc
